text:
Sam H: quick idea — thinking about an "entropy shielding" pattern for config changes that affect routing/quotas. goal: reduce blast radius from sudden distribution shifts when a flag flips. thoughts? :thinking_face:
Anita M: love the name. can you sketch the safety model? e.g., cohort sampling + staggered ramp + automatic rollback triggers?
Sam H: yeah — rough idea: 1) pin a tiny cohort (0.5%) 2) observe routing qps/cpu/error deltas for X minutes 3) expand to 5% if metrics stable, else auto-revert. want this tied into the console so PMs can do quick canaries without paging eng.
Kevin P: two nitpicks: 1) config propagation semantics — do we do eventual consistent rollout or coordinated push? coordinated is harder across regions. 2) TTL for temporary overrides — we need to ensure a stale override doesn't persist and accidentally widen a cohort.
Lina C: dashboard-wise we should expose a single-pane "shield view" that shows: current cohort %, delta latency (p50/p95), route-fanout, quota-consumption, and a diff of the route-policy before vs after. quick filters for model + customer tier.
ops-bot: deploy-notice: rollout-controller v2 applied 1749995100 by kevin-p. CI: ok.
Anita M: +1 to auto-revert triggers. also propose a safety heuristic: if route fanout increases by >15% OR any new error class appears, revert immediately and notify oncall + the offline audit channel.
Sam H: example config snippet for the controller — simple schema proposal:
```
{"shield": {"initial_pct": 0.5, "step_pct": 5, "observe_minutes": 15, "metrics": ["p95_latency","error_rate","quota_burn_rate"], "auto_revert_on": {"error_rate": ">0.5%", "p95_latency": ">200ms"}}}
```
Kevin P: schema looks fine. but consider requiring a "safety_quorum": ["telemetry>=healthy","no_recent_incidents"]. otherwise teams can opt into too-aggressive ramps. also, make the controller emit idempotent events so replaying doesn't double-expand cohorts.
Product UX: for console flow — show an inline preflight that simulates the steps and estimated exposure (expected tokens affected, estimated cost delta). allow a checkbox "require ops approval" for high-criticality routes.
Lina C: telemetry query examples for the preflight:
- baseline: SELECT p50,p95,error_rate FROM route_metrics WHERE route_id = :id AND ts BETWEEN now()-1h AND now()
- compare: same query scoped to cohort hash in the first 15m after flip.
Sam H: who owns the audit trail? we need immutable history of who scheduled the shield, the snapshot of affected configs, and the exact cohort seed. super important for compliance audits.
Anita M: ops should own storage (encrypted ledger) but UI + API in platform repo. add an event: "shield.activation" with metadata.
Kevin P: small API note: prefer PATCH /runtime-shields/:id with a well-defined state machine (pending -> active -> expanding -> reverted -> complete). avoids ad-hoc toggles. include ETag optimistic concurrency for safety.
Sam H: ok good action items: 1) Kevin + Lina draft API + telemetry queries 2) Anita + Product UX design console preflight and auto-revert rules 3) Sam to prototype controller with a default safety_quorum and TTL for overrides 4) ops to propose audit storage options.
Product UX: i'll mock a tiny flow by EOD and ping design review. :sparkles:
Lina C: i'll add dashboard widgets and the preflight queries to the telemetry repo.
Kevin P: starting on the API sketch now. will link PR when ready.
Sam H: thanks all — putting this into a short RFC. linking draft here: https://redwood-internal/rfcs/entropy-shielding (WIP). if anyone wants to be coauthor, say so here.
Anita M: happy to coauthor.
ops-bot: reminder: oncall rotation this week: will notify if auto-revert triggers. :rotating_light:
